```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
skills = pd.DataFrame({
    '技术领域': ['分子克隆', '基因组组装', 'QTL定位', 'Python编程'],
    '熟练程度': [90, 85, 88, 92]
})
skills.to_csv('skills.csv', index=False)

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(ggplot2)
skills <- read.csv('skills.csv')
ggplot(skills, aes(x=技术领域, y=熟练程度)) +
  geom_col(fill="#3498DB") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="技术能力雷达图") +
  coord_polar()
